subject: Issue with converting activity log into data.frame

messages.author: 70255d6ca442dbb2
messages.subject: Issue with converting activity log into data.frame
parts:
Dear Vincent and Jairo,

first of all, thank you for this great package!

For my study I aim to assess people's level of PA in the 20 minutes before they complete a cognitive test. Hence, I created a log file indicating the segmentation moments (i.e. 20 min. before starting the cognitive test and the moment of starting the cognitive test). 

For some days I obtain the correct segments. However, for other days this is not the case. I used the 'g.conv.actlog' function and noticed that there is a problem with converting the log file into date.frame. 





For example, line 5 is correct. However, on the other lines the 'testtime' is not taken into account.

 Please find attached the log file. 

I use R version 4.3.1 and Windows 10. Thank you for any help you can provide regarding this matter.

Best regards,
Louise

messages.author: 05de4f382b390d3d
messages.subject: Re: Issue with converting activity log into data.frame
parts:
Dear Louise,

Please look at the documentation for the activity log here. GGIR expects an activity log containing one participant per row, with days organized in columns (wide format). You are providing a long-formatted activity log with a different row for every day of measurement for the same participant.

Best,
Jairo

messages.subject: Re: Issue with converting activity log into data.frame
parts:
Hi Jairo,

I found the cause of the problem. I saw that only times ending with "5" or "0" seconds were correctly captured. The problem was solved by rounding the times to 5 seconds or by setting the epoch at 1.

Kind regards,
Louise
